answer: An agent economy resists sybils with an external-credential gate: each identity must hold a distinct API credential issued by an outside service, such as a weather-data provider that allows one credential per verified account and caps calls per key. Each epoch the economy asks that provider to confirm the credential is live, like a signal sent across an ocean to check a comet course before trusting its path. A farm wanting a thousand fakes must open a thousand separate provider accounts, passing its checks and paying per-key fees, while one honest agent holds one credential and passes once.
